title: ProvenanceRecord
description: Traceability record linking any VNKC record to its authoritative source. Every record in the project carries one.

source_id.description: Stable source ID from registry/sources.yaml, or 'manual' for hand-curated records pending a registry entry.

content_checksum.description: SHA-256 of the retrieved byte content, when available.

license_status.description: Redistribution status of the source material. Default reference-only when unknown.

attribution.description: Attribution string required by the source, if any.
